notes.title: Transition to paid game
notes.content:
We’re excited to share some important news about the future of Gameartopia. Starting on January 1, 2025, Gameartopia will transition from being free-to-play to a paid game, priced at  0.99€.
Why this change?

Since its launch, Gameartopia has grown in amazing ways, thanks to your incredible support. To ensure we can continue improving the game, adding exciting new features, and providing ongoing support, we need to move to a more sustainable model. This transition will allow us to:

    Enhance the overall quality of the game with regular updates.
    Introduce new content and features to keep things fresh.
    Maintain technical support and expand the reach of the community.

What happens to current players?

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has downloaded and played Gameartopia so far. If you already own the game before January 1, 2025, you’ll continue to enjoy it without any additional cost. This change only affects new players downloading the game after the transition date.

What’s next?

The transition to a paid model will take place on January 1, 2025. Until then, Gameartopia remains free to download, so invite your friends to join before the change!

Thank you for being a part of our amazing community. This is just the beginning of an exciting new chapter for Gameartopia. Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to share your thoughts and questions in the comments or on our forums.

Thank you for your understanding and support,

Bicelula
